thread:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for model: rdx-v2-quant (eu-west-1) — 10% traffic -> canary pool :rocket:

lucy: getting reports from a customer saying inference 502s spiking around 12:02 UTC. They sent logs.

oncall-bot: @aaron paged (severity: P1) — elevated error rate detected on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 (5xx > 5% over 3m).

aaron: acked. jumping on it. any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: yes — rdx-v2-quant rolled to canary at 12:00 UTC. traffic percent: 10%.

nina: I'm seeing a 4.8% 5xx rate on the public LB, latency tail rising. Checking model pool logs.

kai: I pulled one of the canary instances. Replica logs show rapid model load retries and OOM messages from the quantized kernel loader. snippet: ```
[2025-06-03T12:03:11Z] ERROR kernel_loader: failed to map quant table: KERNEL_MMAP_ERR
[2025-06-03T12:03:11Z] INFO infer: restarting worker due to OOM
```

jorge: Which instance types? canary used a mix of c6i and g5a mixed pools for eu-west canaries. older c6i don't support the chosen optimized kernel (AVX512) fallback causing memory blowouts.

nina: that matches. I'm also seeing long GC pauses while the runtime swaps quant tables, which pushes the request queue over circuit-breaker thresholds.

cassie: CS flagged a few affected customers with latency-sensitive endpoints. Lucy, can you confirm which customers and how bad?

lucy: two customers reported 10-30% failed requests for inference calls since 12:02. One is running production traffic (non-empty prompt traffic). They've temporarily routed some requests to another region but still seeing degraded behavior from our API.

aaron: impact looks real. mitigation options? kill the canary feature flag, rollback model, or widen canary to different instance type.

nina: immediate -> flip canary kill-switch to stop traffic to rdx-v2-quant. secondary -> rollback to rdx-v2-stable if flipping doesn't clear. I'll flip the flag now.

nina: /ops feature-flag set canary-model-eu-west rdx-v2-quant false

deploy-bot: Feature flag 'canary-model-eu-west' set to false by nina at 12:06 UTC. Routing will shift to previous baseline variants.

nina: monitoring... error rate dropping but still elevated because of queued retries. I'll scale up fallback pool and flush pending queues.

kai: commands I'm running: ```
# scale fallback pool replicas
redwoodctl pool scale fallback-eu-west --replicas 8
# drain canary hosts from LB
kubectl patch svc rdx-infer-eu --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/sessionAffinity","value":"None"}]'
```

aaron: ETA for full recovery?

nina: error rate back to baseline (~0.4%) at 12:09 after feature flag flip + scale. We still have one noisy canary host in the pool being drained. I'll force-delete the problematic pod.

kai: removed the pod. logs show the model variant attempted to pick AVX512 kernels even on non-AVX hosts due to a build mislabel. Root cause: the quant build artifact didn't include a clear cpu-capability tag so the kernel selector picked an incompatible optimized kernel.

jorge: deployment pipeline mis-tag step: the artifact manifest lacked the cpu_features: [avx,avx2,avx512] field. That would cause the runtime's kernel selector to assume availability. Fixing pipeline now.

cassie: customer comms — Lucy, pls update affected customers: apologetic note + short mitigation summary + ETA for postmortem.

lucy: will send an interim note within 20m. highlighting that traffic was diverted and canary was disabled; offering follow-up once we have root cause.

nina: creating incident ticket and assigning to eng-runtime and infra for a postmortem. adding tags: canary, model-variant, quantization, kernel-selector, eu-west.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2025-1987 created by nina. Severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 after mitigation at 12:09 UTC.

aaron: handing off to kai for deeper root cause and remediation. I'm off for now but will monitor the ticket. @kai you own the follow-ups and rollbacks to the pipeline.

kai: ack. I'll: 1) patch pipeline to emit cpu_features metadata, 2) add a runtime guard to refuse AVX512 kernels on hosts without CPUID check, 3) add a canary run that forces mixed-instance validation. ETA: 24h for pipeline patch, 72h for runtime guard and canary.

cassie: schedule a 1-hr blameless postmortem tomorrow with runtime+infra+devex. include customer success for communications.

lucy: interim customer note dispatched at 12:22 UTC.

nina: final status: traffic rolled back, error rate normalized, no further customer impact reported after 12:10. closing paging loop.

aaron: thanks team. please add any lingering action items to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:

kai: adding action items now. leaving thread for next on-call.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout halted and canary artifact reverted to baseline at 12:09 UTC.

oncall-bot: @aaron acknowledged. Handoff complete to kai.

(END OF THREAD)
